title: Singapore Shares May Bounce Higher Again On Friday
text:
Singapore Shares May Bounce Higher Again On Friday August 02, 2018, 08:00:00 Singapore stock market on Thursday halted the two-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost 35 points or 1 percent. The Straits Times Index now rests just above the 3,285-point plateau although it's poised to rebound STI finished sharply financials, properties, industrials and plantations.
For the day, the index retreated 42.63 points or 1.28 percent to finish at 3,286.32 after trading between 3,278.84 and 3,329.19. Volume was 1.84 billion shares worth 1.23 billion Singapore dollars. There were 265 decliners and 124 gainers.
Among the actives, Comfort DelGro plummeted 2.53 percent, while Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation plunged 2.24 percent, United Overseas Bank tumbled 2.05 percent, Keppel Corp skidded 1.88 percent, SembCorp Industries dropped 1.87 percent, DBS Group declined 1.63 percent, CapitaLand retreated 1.25 percent, CapitaLand Commercial Trust shed 1.15 percent, Genting Singapore lost 0.79 percent, Wilmar International slid 0.63 percent, SingTel fell 0.31 percent and Hutchison Port Holdings, Golden Agri-Resources, Thai Beverage, Ascendas REIT and Yangzijiang Shipbuilding ( AAPL ) fueled //www.rttnews.com/2922638/singapore-shares-may-bounce-higher-again-on-friday.aspx )
